entries.name: denominator_graph
entries.claim: The mature archive should expose the denominator of attempts, failures, reversals, abandoned lines, and practice-lag states hidden by positive-result canons.
entries.operational_implication: Records should link claims, sources, status history, cases, patterns, and genealogy rather than accumulate as isolated pages.
entries.risk_if_ignored: The project becomes an entertaining list of famous errors and loses its transformative value.

entries.name: status_history_before_verdict
entries.claim: Many records need timelines of epistemic status rather than one static status label.
entries.operational_implication: Schemas should support status_history arrays and explicit update/rollback triggers.
entries.risk_if_ignored: Contested, revived, narrowed, and practice-persistent claims will be flattened into misleading verdicts.

entries.name: genealogy_as_transmission_explanation
entries.claim: Genealogy belongs because it explains how errors, methods, critiques, and corrections move through people, labs, institutions, conferences, books, and lineages.
entries.operational_implication: Influence records should connect to claim and pattern records when evidence supports the link.
entries.risk_if_ignored: The archive will know what failed but not why similar failures recurred.

entries.name: pattern_records_must_be_earned
entries.claim: Recurring-pattern records should be promoted only after multiple sourced records demonstrate recurrence.
entries.operational_implication: Keep pattern candidates in queue until at least two or three linked cases support them.
entries.risk_if_ignored: The archive will smuggle theory into evidence and recreate the overclaiming it is meant to study.

entries.name: failure_literacy_curriculum
entries.claim: At maturity, the archive can teach graduate students, engineers, policymakers, journalists, and AI systems how to reason with failure, uncertainty, and correction.
entries.operational_implication: Pedagogical summaries should be downstream of source-backed records, not substitutes for them.
entries.risk_if_ignored: The project will either stay too raw for public learning or teach from unsourced anecdotes.

entries.name: correction_memory_commons
entries.claim: The cube should preserve not only failures but the surfaces that make correction visible and durable.
entries.operational_implication: Infrastructure records are foundational; every domain should be evaluated by its failure-memory capture systems.
entries.risk_if_ignored: The archive will tell stories of failure without explaining why some failures become reusable knowledge and others vanish.

entries.name: earned_capabilities_over_record_count
entries.claim: The cube's progress should be measured by what it enables users to know or avoid, not by how many records it contains.
entries.operational_implication: Future revisions should state which capability they earn or which weakness they test.

entries.name: open_future_not_schema_obedience
entries.claim: Current schemas are scaffolds, not destiny.
entries.operational_implication: Future sessions may add, split, merge, or replace record types when doing so preserves truth better.
entries.risk_if_ignored: The archive will overfit early categories and hide phenomena that do not fit them.

entries.name: resumability_as_infrastructure
entries.claim: A 10k+ revision cube must make resumption easy and honest.
entries.operational_implication: Every revision should update handoff surfaces and distinguish what changed from what did not.
entries.risk_if_ignored: Future sessions will waste attention reconstructing state or accidentally repeat old mistakes.

rev0003_operationalization.implementation: First source-backed nodes now distinguish sources, incidents, claims, and pattern candidate rather than collapsing them into a story.

rev0007_operationalization.implementation: Added near-miss/source-infrastructure records so the corpus begins to capture pre-catastrophe weak signals, not only retrospective famous failures.

rev0014_operationalization.implementation: Added FOUNDATION-TELOS-LEDGER, EARNED-CAPABILITY-LEDGER, DREAM-REGISTER, and FUTURE-SESSION-RESUME-LEDGER; no case records were added.
